task_name: Fix round 1: explorer behaviour (F-001, F-003, F-004, F-005, F-006, F-008)
description: F-001: FiltersPopover is placed by placeFiltersPopover(): under its button with max-height = window height - 8 - top (capped at the .menu 420 px), or above the button (bottom-anchored) when its measured content does not fit below and there is more room above; it scrolls inside (.menu overflow-y: auto), keeps the right-aligned horizontal clamp, and is placed again on window resize. F-003: new optional `visible` prop (default true, passed from App.tsx); when the explorer's view becomes hidden the Filters popover is closed (filtersOpen false, focus not moved), and it is never mounted while hidden, so a hidden explorer holds no Escape layer, mousedown or resize listener; on return the Filters button reads aria-expanded=false; a switch between Graph, Wiki and OpenSpec still leaves an open popover open. F-004: on a hidden-to-visible transition after the catalog has loaded, the explorer re-reads the catalog once without a loading state; an unchanged snapshot updates only the graph freshness (graph, graphReason) through a `freshness` override, so selection, filters, panel, history, the Wiki article and relationships do not reload; a changed snapshot replaces the catalog as any reload does. F-005: openPath takes a lookup token per link click; only the latest lookup may open a target or show the unresolved-path message. F-006: seenNodes is filled in an effect keyed on `nodes`, not in the render body. F-008: OpenSpecView choose() calls onLocation before zeroing the content scroll, so the entry being left records its offset; B still opens at its top.

noticed_not_touched.what: Effects in Explorer (detail, relationships, documents, suggested Wiki) depend on the catalog object identity, so any catalog reload with an unchanged snapshot (Retry, Refresh, a new reader identity) blanks the Wiki article and re-reads relationships; F-004 avoids this only for the return re-read via a freshness override

The relationships effect still tests `catalog.graph === "missing"` for protocol 1, not the freshness override; with an unchanged snapshot the graph state can only move between ready and stale, so the branch is unaffected today
The Filters popover is positioned once per open and on resize, not when its anchor moves because the content pane scrolls under it

assumptions: A quiet re-read that returns the same snapshotId means nodes, edges and counts are unchanged, so only graph and graphReason are applied; a changed snapshotId replaces the catalog as any reload does (selection dropped only when the node is gone, the existing rule).

behavior_changes.description: F-003: leaving the explorer's view (Sessions, Flows, …) closes an open Filters popover without moving focus; on return the Filters button is shown closed; the filters and the rest of the explorer state are kept; a switch between Graph, Wiki and OpenSpec inside the explorer still leaves it open. Operator's answer: «Закрывать при уходе (Recommended)». The implemented choice changed after the answer: the first implementation kept the popover open state across the view switch (unmounted while hidden, shown again on return).
alternatives: Keep the open state across the view switch: unmount the popover while hidden and show it again, focus moving into it, on return (the first implementation, not chosen).

behavior_changes.description: F-001: when the popover's content does not fit below its button and there is more room above, it opens upward, bottom edge 4 px above the button, following the shared Menu's auto placement; otherwise it opens below, height bounded by the room to the window bottom minus 8 px. Operator's answer: «Над кнопкой (Recommended)»; kept as implemented.
alternatives: Always open below and only bound its height (it may become a very short scrolling box when the button is low in the window).

not_touched.reason: The shared .menu rule already scrolls (overflow-y: auto); the height bound must follow the measured anchor, so it is set inline by FiltersPopover.
F-008 reproduced in OpenSpecView.choose(); the hook's navigate(..., { resetContent: true }) already seeds the new entry at 0 and needed no change.
App.tsx only gains `visible={view === "metaproject"}` on MetaprojectView; rendering the whole App is outside this test's seam. The test still passes.

notes: Every finding reproduced (red against HEAD in the scratch copy). suggested_fix diverged: F-001 — besides bounding max-height by the room below, the popover flips above its button when that has more room (Menu.tsx auto placement) and re-places on resize; the bound is inline, not in metaproject.css. F-003 now follows the suggestion after the operator's answer: setFiltersOpen(false) when the view becomes hidden (no focus return), plus the popover is not mounted while hidden; the first implementation kept it open across the switch (see behavior_changes). suggested_fix diverged: F-004 — no load-age threshold; every hidden-to-visible return after the first load re-reads once, and an unchanged snapshot applies only graph/graphReason so the content does not reload (a plain revision bump would have blanked the Wiki article and re-read relationships). F-005 and F-006 follow the suggestions; F-005's token is taken on every link click, so a later click that opens a loaded node or names an invalid path also retires an earlier pending lookup. F-008 follows the 'record the offsets before zeroing' variant: onLocation first, then scrollTop = 0. Not covered by a red test: the one-line App.tsx wiring of `visible` (verified by tsc only).
